nodes.label: Persistent plugin chip bar
nodes.rationale: Plugin-only pattern with no CloudTAK core changes: a permanent launcher chip, plus optional minimize of a desktop float that restores the same size and position. This plugin does not use host api.bottomBar. On enable it mounts its own strip on .map-shell at the top of the map, docked to the right of DataSync, so a stock CloudTAK VPS matches local (host chips would stay bottom-center). The chip is registered on enable and removed only on disable, so users can launch without finding the menu first. Incident Manager's key is incident-manager (BOTTOM_BAR_KEY). Chip click calls openDesktopPane and is a no-op if the float is already visible. Desktop only; mobile keeps MenuTemplate. Close does not notify the plugin, so the chip remains. Reference implementation is floatMinimize.ts, IncidentManagerTaskbarChip.vue, MinimizePaneAction.vue, IncidentManagerFloatShell.vue, and index.ts.

nodes.label: Minimize remounts the float
nodes.rationale: Minimize snapshots x/y/width/height via useFloatStore, removes the pane, and leaves the chip. A later add remounts it. State survives through module scope, sessionStorage, or mission persistence (this plugin uses useIncident). Unsaved local field drafts may reset. Re-adding while the pane is open resets geometry, so has(uid) returns early. Geometry across a full page reload, and a core minimized plus v-show hide without remount, are out of scope. If plugin Vue diverges from the host's Vue, component types are cast through PluginAPI float and bottomBar parameter types.
